result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks and basic stop-sign control. While pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps and marked crosswalks are present, they appear faded and the environment is dominated by on-street parking that may limit visibility.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street in the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs of both intersecting streets.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven pavement in the roadway and near the gutter can create trip hazards or difficulties for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface throughout the intersection area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a school zone intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and flashing school crossing signals. result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks and row housing, but the pedestrian environment is compromised by faded crossing markings and poor sightlines. Parked vehicles and overgrown vegetation at the corner create significant visual obstructions between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk and stop bar are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Corner Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large bushes and parked cars at the intersection corner block the line of sight between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection corner

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the crossing area increases the risk of trips and falls.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection and trim corner vegetation to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the corner.
